entries.honest_status: Residuals (documented, not caught): a scan hidden one level down inside a nested quoted string handed to another interpreter (`bash -c "find / ..."`, `ssh host 'find / ...'`, `docker exec ... find /`) is not unwrapped — only the outer command string's own segments are parsed. Fix: for a worktree whose basename matches `agent-*` (the harness's own dispatch-time naming), `_live_owner` treats that agent's OWN transcript file mtime (`<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl`, appended to continuously while the agent works — verified against this session's own transcript, not assumed) as the PRIMARY liveness signal, checked before the heartbeat/claim join and requiring no dispatch-path change. ROUND 2 (harness-review, 2026-07-17): the round-1 fix above was itself found to be UNREACHABLE for a locked agent worktree — `classify_worktree`'s pre-existing `*,locked,*` structural-skip returned BEFORE the liveness split (and therefore before the transcript-mtime check) ever ran, for ANY locked worktree. Proven on the reviewing machine: the dispatch/isolation mechanism locks an agent's worktree for the full dispatch duration and only unlocks on clean completion, so THREE real dead-pid locked worktrees existed on that machine at review time, none of them ever reaching this detector's liveness logic at all. Fixed: `classify_worktree` no longer lets `locked` preempt an `agent-*`-named worktree specifically — it falls through to the normal dirty/unique computation and the liveness split, exactly as an unlocked agent worktree would, with `_live_owner` now taking a third `is_locked` argument so a stale-transcript-and-locked verdict reports the distinct label `agent-crashed-locked` (vs. plain `agent-transcript-stale` for stale-but-unlocked) — informative for salvage, since `git worktree remove` refuses on a locked worktree (a single `--force` is NOT enough; verified: `git worktree unlock <path>` first, or `git worktree remove -f -f <path>` [force TWICE], are the only ways through). A LOCKED but FRESH-transcript agent worktree is UNCHANGED-live: lock status carries no liveness information on its own (a live, actively-working agent is ALSO locked for the same reason a crashed one is) — only transcript freshness decides. Non-agent locked worktrees are UNCHANGED (still structural-skip; a manually-locked worktree, e.g. on removable media, is presumed intentionally persistent, unlike a dispatch-locked agent worktree). Also fixed in this round: `_build_agent_tx_cache`'s `find -maxdepth 6` was measured to include the Workflow-dispatch transcript variant (`.../subagents/workflows/wf_<id>/agent-<id>.jsonl`) at EXACTLY depth 6 — zero slack, the same class of silent-miss risk this whole reformulation exists to close — bumped to `-maxdepth 7`. The six mandated non-fires are now structurally guaranteed, not heuristic: (i) a still-live AGENT worktree (locked or not, as of round 2) is excluded via a transcript mtime within AGENT_TX_FRESH_MIN (default 30, same as OBS_STALE_MIN) minutes of now; (ii) a still-live NAMED (non-agent) session's worktree is excluded via the heartbeat/transcript-mtime liveness join (hb_classify live/throttled, including the mid-turn stale-heartbeat-but-fresh-transcript override, plus a CONTINUING-marker grace window for a builder standing by awaiting a scheduled wake) and the invoking session's own SELF-worktree exclusion; (iii) an already-integrated branch is excluded via git-cherry patch-equivalence PLUS merge-base --is-ancestor across all four candidate integration refs (origin/master, origin/main, master, main), so a local merge/cherry-pick that origin merely lags is never false-flagged; (iv) the orchestrator's own primary checkout is excluded twice over (the sweep's unconditional primary-skip plus the SELF check); (v) an agent-transcript cache lookup can only ADD ownership for `agent-*`-named worktrees specifically (anchored exact-basename match) — it is structurally inert for every non-agent worktree, so it can never suppress or alter the pre-existing heartbeat-based verdict for a named session; (vi) a LOCKED agent worktree that is genuinely still live is never false-flagged either — `is_locked` only ever narrows the VERDICT LABEL on an already-orphaned classification (agent-transcript-stale vs. agent-crashed-locked), it never feeds into the fresh/stale decision itself, so a live-but-locked agent takes the exact same early `agent-transcript-fresh` return path as a live-and-unlocked one. RESIDUAL (named, not eliminated — accepted for a WARN-only, never-auto-pruning surfacer): an agent that goes silent for longer than AGENT_TX_FRESH_MIN while genuinely still working (one very long reasoning/tool call with no intermediate transcript flush) could false-fire past the window; widening the window would materially delay real-orphan detection for the far more common crash/stall cases this entry exists to catch, so the tradeoff is kept at parity with the session-level OBS_STALE_MIN default rather than widened further. Also still bounded to the mode-(b) standing-by window past its grace and MSYS pid-liveness unreliability (mitigated by preferring transcript-mtime, which is platform-independent, over a pid check) — all advisory-only and non-destructive (nothing is ever auto-pruned; a locked worktree is additionally NEVER SAFE-PRUNE regardless of this fix, both because `git worktree remove` itself refuses on locked and because `classify_worktree` explicitly excludes `is_locked` from the SAFE-PRUNE promotion). worktree-hygiene-sweep.sh's own --self-test covers every excluded case explicitly (round-1: 39/39 — the original 34 live/throttled/CONTINUING-grace/fresh-claim/already-merged/self exclusions plus 5 REFORMULATION assertions for fresh/stale/unaffected-non-agent; round 2 adds 4 more proving (d) a LOCKED agent worktree with a stale transcript and content is ORPHANED with the agent-crashed-locked verdict and salvage text naming the unlock step [3 assertions], and (e) a LOCKED agent worktree with a FRESH transcript stays LIVE-OWNED, unaffected by the lock [1 assertion] — verified by an actual run: 43/43 total, 0 failed); the doctor adds its own agent-worktree fixture (oww-agent-live-green: dirty + zero heartbeat coverage + fresh transcript -> no WARN) on top of its pre-existing dirty/clean/live-owned fixtures (WARN present for a dirty orphan, absent for clean/merged/live-owned); both the doctor and the digest delegate entirely to this same detector, so they inherit both rounds' fixes with no changes of their own beyond the doctor's own fixture additions.
